name: diag_g01_concurrency_analysis_01
command:
import datetime as dt,hashlib,json,os,re
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools.t01_partition import ROOT,audited_result
from src.tools.t01v2_live_progress import read_prefix,archive,observed_counts
from src.tools.g01_admission import validate_source_admission
name=os.environ['CVPR_RUN_NAME']; collection='gen_train_concurrency_s15_02'; job='707841.hopper-m-02'
scenes=['FloorPlan1','FloorPlan7','FloorPlan203','FloorPlan204','FloorPlan301','FloorPlan401']
kinds=['direct_flip','direct_stay','look_flip','look_stay']
folder=ROOT/'logs/review'/name;folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
parent,pref=audited_result('results/'+collection+'.json');pm=parent['metrics'];pc=parent['config']
assert pc['pbs_jobid']==job and pc['gpus']==1 and pc['scenes']==scenes and pc['concurrencies']==[2,4,6]
assert parent['_meta']['end'] and pm['all_planned_assignments_finished'] and not pm['unfinished_run_names']
assert len(pm['scene_runs'])==len(pm['started_shards'])==18 and len(pm['stages'])==3
archive((ROOT/pref['file']).read_bytes(),folder,'parent.json')
pattern=re.compile(r'UnityProcessException|Segmentation fault|SIGSEGV|SIGABRT|Unity[^\n]{0,120}(?:crash|unexpected[^\n]{0,30}exit)',re.I)
def strings(x):
 if isinstance(x,str):yield x
 elif isinstance(x,dict):
  for y in x.values():yield from strings(y)
 elif isinstance(x,list):
  for y in x:yield from strings(y)
def rate(n,d):return {'numerator':n,'denominator':d,'fraction':n/d if d else None}
rows=[];stages=[]
for stage in pm['stages']:
 c=stage['concurrency'];group=[];configured=pc['stage_plans'][stage['stage_index']]
 assert stage['completed'] and stage['fixed_scenes']==scenes and stage['admission_state_at_stage_end']=={'active_leases':{},'poison':None}
 raw=Path(stage['plan']['plan_file']).read_bytes();plan=json.loads(raw)
 assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==stage['plan']['plan_sha256']==configured['plan_sha256']
 assert plan==configured['plan'] and plan['pbs_jobid']==job and plan['gpu_uuid']==pc['parent_cuda_visible_devices']
 assert plan['cpu_affinity']==pc['cpu_affinity'] and len(set(plan['cpu_affinity']))==12
 assert plan['max_unity_instances']<=8 and plan['scenes']==scenes
 planref=archive(raw,folder,f'c{c}_admission_plan.json')
 for scene in scenes:
  child=f'{collection}_c{c}_{scene.lower()}'
  matches=[x for x in pm['scene_runs'] if x['run_name']==child];starts=[x for x in pm['started_shards'] if x['run_name']==child]
  assert len(matches)==len(starts)==1
  record=matches[0];started=starts[0];data,source=audited_result(record['result_path']);m=data['metrics'];cfg=data['config'];meta=data['_meta']
  assert all(source[k]==record['source'][k] for k in ('file','sha256','metrics_sha256','exit_code','git_commit'))
  assert meta['end'] and cfg['name']==child and cfg['scene']==scene and record['gpu_uuid']==plan['gpu_uuid']
  assert record['granted_timeout_seconds']==1200 and record['reported_passed_by_class']==m['passed_by_class']
  shardraw=Path(started['shard_config']).read_bytes()
  assert hashlib.sha256(shardraw).hexdigest()==started['shard_config_sha256'] and json.loads(shardraw)==cfg['shard']
  assert validate_source_admission(cfg,m)==plan
  journal=ROOT/cfg['attempt_journal'];captured,extent=read_prefix(journal,limit=journal.stat().st_size+1)
  assert not extent['read_cap_reached'] and extent['trailing_incomplete_bytes_not_counted']==0
  assert hashlib.sha256(captured).hexdigest()==m['attempt_journal_sha256']
  counts=observed_counts(captured,scene)
  assert counts['observed_reported_passed_by_class']==m['passed_by_class']
  assert counts['observed_complete_attempts']==m['attempts']==record['reported_attempts']
  jref=archive(captured,folder,child+'_attempts.jsonl');jr=[json.loads(x) for x in captured.decode().splitlines() if x.strip()]
  leases=m['g01_witness_admission']['lease_records']
  errors=[m.get('error'),m.get('discovery_failures'),m.get('controller_visits'),[r.get('discard_reasons') for r in jr],[v.get('receive_error_before_cleanup') for v in leases]]
  crash=sorted(set(x for x in strings(errors) if pattern.search(x)))
  crashlines=[{'line':i+1,'text':v} for i,v in enumerate((ROOT/meta['log_path']).read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()) if pattern.search(v)]
  error=m.get('error');e=error if isinstance(error,str) else json.dumps(error,sort_keys=True)
  item={'name':child,'scene':scene,'concurrency':c,'source':source,'journal':jref,
   'duration_seconds_logged':meta['duration_sec'],'wrapper_wall_seconds_observed':record['wall_seconds_observed'],
   'attempts':counts['observed_complete_attempts'],'source_reported_pairs':m['passed_by_class'],
   'status':m['status'],'exit_code':meta['exit_code'],'error':error,'black':m['black_frame_detected'],
   'explicit_deadline':e.startswith('TimeoutError:') and any(x in e.lower() for x in ('deadline','reserved time','cleanup reserve')),
   'native_action_timeout':e.startswith('TimeoutError: Error encountered when running action '),
   'unexpected_worker_failure':m.get('status')=='worker_failed' or 'WorkerExit' in e,
   'explicit_native_crash_evidence':crash,'explicit_native_crash_log_lines':crashlines,
   'cleanup_errors':m['cleanup_errors'],'admission_cleanup_confirmed':m['g01_witness_admission']['cleanup_confirmed'],
   'witness_lease_count':len(leases),'witness_nonzero_exitcodes':[v['worker_exitcode'] for v in leases if v['worker_exitcode']!=0],
   'raw_storage_cap':m['search_raw_storage']['raw_saving_stopped']}
  rows.append(item);group.append(item)
 counts={k:sum(x['source_reported_pairs'][k] for x in group) for k in kinds}
 seconds=stage['wall_seconds_observed'];total=sum(counts.values());slow=min(counts.values())
 s={'concurrency':c,'scene_count':len(group),'gpu_count':1,'gpu_uuid':plan['gpu_uuid'],'node':plan['node'],'plan':planref,
  'max_unity_instances':plan['max_unity_instances'],'witness_capacity':plan['witness_capacity'],
  'wall_seconds':seconds,'gpu_wall_hours_not_billing':seconds/3600,'scenes_per_gpu_hour':len(group)*3600/seconds,
  'source_reported_pairs':counts,'source_reported_pair_count':total,'source_reported_pairs_per_gpu_hour':total*3600/seconds,
  'gpu_wall_seconds_per_source_pair':seconds/total if total else None,
  'native_crash_evidence_rate':rate(sum(bool(x['explicit_native_crash_evidence'] or x['explicit_native_crash_log_lines']) for x in group),len(group)),
  'nonzero_exit_rate':rate(sum(x['exit_code']!=0 for x in group),len(group)),
  'cleanup_error_rate':rate(sum(bool(x['cleanup_errors']) or not x['admission_cleanup_confirmed'] for x in group),len(group)),
  'raw_cap_scene_count':sum(x['raw_storage_cap'] for x in group),
  'estimate_1700_unbalanced_candidate_gpu_hours':1700*seconds/total/3600 if total else None,
  'estimate_425_each_class_bottleneck_gpu_hours':425*seconds/slow/3600 if slow else None,
  'estimate_bottleneck_classes':[k for k in kinds if counts[k]==slow],
  'independently_qualified_pair_throughput':None}
 for key in ('black','explicit_deadline','native_action_timeout','unexpected_worker_failure'):s[key+'_rate']=rate(sum(x[key] for x in group),len(group))
 stages.append(s)
eligible=[s for s in stages if all(s[k]['numerator']==0 for k in ('black_rate','cleanup_error_rate','unexpected_worker_failure_rate','native_crash_evidence_rate'))]
fastest=max(eligible,key=lambda x:x['source_reported_pairs_per_gpu_hour']) if eligible else None
summary={'observed_at_utc':dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'collection':collection,'pbs_jobid':job,'parent':pref,
 'parent_wrapper_seconds':parent['_meta']['duration_sec'],'stage_seconds_sum':sum(s['wall_seconds'] for s in stages),
 'wrapper_minus_stage_seconds':parent['_meta']['duration_sec']-sum(s['wall_seconds'] for s in stages),
 'stages':stages,'scenes':rows,
 'scope':'Actual single-GPU stage timing, not charged PBS usage. Six fixed training scenes repeated per stage; no cross-stage additive pool count. All pairs source-reported, not independently accepted.',
 'failure_scope':'Explicit native crash/signal evidence only; true native crash incidence remains unknown without definitive exit telemetry. Native action timeout is neither automatically a crash nor automatically an explicit scene deadline.',
 'planning_estimates':{'target':1700,'balanced_per_class':425,
 'unbalanced_formula':'1700 * stage_seconds / total_source_candidates / 3600',
 'balanced_formula':'425 * stage_seconds / minimum_class_source_candidates / 3600',
 'zero_denominator':'unknown/not estimable; never replaced',
 'limits':'Scenario extrapolations only, excluding one-time gate/parent overhead. Stage wall already includes concurrency: no second division. Scene heterogeneity, aggregate cap8, dedup, independent checks, full tables and balancing may reduce yield.',
 'remaining_charged_G01_budget':None,'canonical_accounting':'g01_concurrency_final_accounting_01 owned by root; no repeated billing query'},
 'recommendation':{'provisional_concurrency':fastest['concurrency'] if fastest else None,
 'first_recheck_scenes':scenes,'partition':'training only',
 'condition':'After metadata fix, recheck the same fixed six scenes and independent output acceptance before expansion. c6 FloorPlan301 native-action timeout remains unresolved; resource-clean does not mean proven simulator-stable. Keep zero-yield FloorPlan401 visible.',
 'possible_later_training_ranges':['FloorPlan8-10','FloorPlan205-207','FloorPlan302-304','FloorPlan402-404'],
 'large_scale_ready':False}}
with (folder/'analysis.json').open('x') as f:json.dump(summary,f,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
def fraction(s,key):
 r=s[key];return str(r['numerator'])+'/'+str(r['denominator'])+' ('+format(r['fraction']*100,'.1f')+'%)'
def num(v):return '不可估计' if v is None else format(v,'.2f')
lines=['G01 707841：同一 H200、12 CPU、相同六个训练场景的并发实测。GPU wall 是 parent 实际阶段计时，含阶段内启动/清理，排除阶段外 gate/parent 开销，不是 PBS 实扣。三档是重复试验，候选不跨档相加，全部 source-reported，未称独立合格。','',
'| 并发 | GPU wall小时 | 场景/卡时 | DF / DS / LF / LS | 候选/卡时 | 卡秒/候选 | 黑帧 | 原生崩溃证据† | 明确deadline | 原生action超时 | 1700未平衡估算卡时 | 每类425瓶颈估算卡时 |',
'|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|']
for s in stages:
 cells=[str(s['concurrency']),format(s['gpu_wall_hours_not_billing'],'.4f'),num(s['scenes_per_gpu_hour']),' / '.join(str(s['source_reported_pairs'][k]) for k in kinds),num(s['source_reported_pairs_per_gpu_hour']),num(s['gpu_wall_seconds_per_source_pair']),
 fraction(s,'black_rate'),fraction(s,'native_crash_evidence_rate'),fraction(s,'explicit_deadline_rate'),fraction(s,'native_action_timeout_rate'),num(s['estimate_1700_unbalanced_candidate_gpu_hours']),num(s['estimate_425_each_class_bottleneck_gpu_hours'])]
 lines.append('| '+' | '.join(cells)+' |')
lines+=['','† 只统计 retained metrics/journal/log 中明确的原生崩溃/信号证据；实际 Unity 原生崩溃率未知，零证据不证明零崩溃。c6/FP301 的 PlaceObjectAtPoint TimeoutError 单列。每档全部六个 child 均非零退出、未完成场景配额；逐场景错误和计数在 analysis.json，资源清理均正常。']
s=fastest
assert s is not None
paragraph=(f"暂选 {s['concurrency']} 场景/卡作为 metadata 修复后的有限小批复验档，源报告速度 {s['source_reported_pairs_per_gpu_hour']:.2f} 候选/卡时；c6 的原生动作超时仍待复查，不能称已证明稳定。先复跑相同六个训练场景 FP1、7、203、204、301、401，保留浴室零产出；证据链和独立验收通过后，再考虑 FP8–10、205–207、302–304、402–404 的小批训练范围。1700 未平衡候选线性外推约 {num(s['estimate_1700_unbalanced_candidate_gpu_hours'])} GPU·小时；每类425的瓶颈外推约 {num(s['estimate_425_each_class_bottleneck_gpu_hours'])} GPU·小时。两者都是规划估算而非完成结果；独立合格速度、完整表筛选损耗和实际 G01 剩余额度未知，不能认定 20 GPU·小时上限或余量足够最终目标。")
lines+=['',paragraph,'','公式：1700×阶段秒/总候选/3600；四类均衡瓶颈：425×阶段秒/最少类别数/3600。已用实际并发阶段时间，不再除并发数。独立校验、T02、去重、场景差异及每场景每类cap8可能进一步增加成本。']
with (folder/'analysis.md').open('x') as f:f.write('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
with (ROOT/'STATUS.md').open('a') as f:f.write('\n\nG01 吞吐一次性分析（'+name+'，'+summary['observed_at_utc']+'）：'+paragraph+' 详细三档表：'+str((folder/'analysis.md').relative_to(ROOT))+'。未提交 GPU、未重复 PBS 记账、旧失败源保留。\n')
print('G01_BENCHMARK_ANALYSIS: '+json.dumps(summary,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
print('REPORT_MARKDOWN: '+str((folder/'analysis.md').relative_to(ROOT)),flush=True)
